thought.title: gelu Shape Adaptive Tiling
thought.description: Shape-adaptive 3-path GELU kernel: N-tiling (TILE_N_MAX=8192) for wide matrices, double-row batching (batchSize=2) for narrow matrices (N≤4096), dynamic UB buffer sizing via bufN*batchSize
thought.reason: Baseline→Kope_v2 差异: (1) 新增 TILE_N_MAX=8192 N维度tiling，对N>8192矩阵沿N轴分块处理——核心机制是ProcessRowTiled按TILE_N_MAX步进，每次CopyInTile/CopyOutTile只处理当前tile段；(2) 双行批处理：N≤4096时batchSize=2，一次处理两行，CopyIn/Compute/CopyOut均以nRows*count为单元——通过增加每次迭代的计算量来摊销kernel launch和访存延迟；(3) 动态UB buffer: bufN = needTiling_ ? TILE_N_MAX : N，总buffer = bufN * batchSize * sizeof(T)——避免为宽矩阵分配过大UB；(4) DataCopyParams: tiled-N路径中用blockCount=2+srcStride/dstStride实现两行跨步GM↔UB拷贝；(5) needTiling_标志位在Init和Process中各计算一次，保证N>8192时正确分派到tiled路径
